scope: Normal command-input magnifier, site-search label typography, and fresh Little input insets in dark appearance.

reference.method: Read-only binary/font/color inspection plus standalone AppKit layout replay and native UI comparison. Arc was not modified.

glyph.name: IcoMoon U+E9CC
glyph.font_placement: NSAttributedString advance and ascender; centered in image view
glyph.provenance: CommandBarInputContainer iconView 0x10222d2f8; constraints 0x10222dacc; image publisher 0x102230628 calls glyph getter 0x100bf334c then 14pt renderer 0x100c20040. The 19pt U+E912 at 0x1022484e0 belongs to another control.

fresh_input.provenance: Input NSStackView 0x10222d1d8; edge binding 0x10222f080/0x10222edc8; standalone native layout fixture accounts for NSTextField alignment insets.

scoped_title.provenance: 0x102237dc8 -> 0x10224aa28 -> 0x100d98d84; NSFontManager weight 7 verified as AppleSystemUIFontMedium. Default base font initializer 0x100d97ed4 is 13pt; title color getter 0x100bd602c.

validation.strict_suite: ShellCheck/bash/zsh pass; existing Lua const-variable error config/nvim/lua/config/tips_tmux.lua:366

limitations: Saturated P3 selection/pill color and native scoped shadow remain discrepant.
Gecko YouTube label advance is 52.6667pt versus native intrinsic 53pt; the pill is 72.6667pt versus native 73pt. Exact pixel/text-raster equivalence is not established.
Main and loaded editor inset branches retain prior geometry and need separate native measurement.
Native CUA captures have no ICC profile and are qualitative evidence, not calibrated color comparisons.
Full browser feature parity and faster-than-Arc performance are not certified.
